# PgCacheable interface

What the [PgCache()](/api/pg-cache/latest/pg-cache.pgcache/) decorator adds to the class it is applied to. A decorated service gains these three members, so code inside the service can reach the cache and the subscription directly.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface PgCacheable 
```
